scope: Recorded local source comparison for one archived GLM fused-MoE UT; not a runtime benchmark or a diagnosis of other GEAK runs.
case_source_difference_scope: Initial suite added a verified frozen-capture loader; the six case-building functions remained AST-identical.
routing_policy: with-replacement sampling of captured regime routing rows
activation_policy: fresh normal random activation values scaled by standard deviation of first captured activation
original_inplace_policy: False in prepared blob static arguments; raw live captured argument was True
actual_primary_metric: harness_lib.serving_weighted_speedup weights baseline_ms by analytic calls (decode1024, prefill64; smaller transient M1 gets1); workload .7/.3 is not directly the primary-score weighting.
optimization_status_evidence: Archived README explicitly says never optimized; null candidate; no accepted patch/e2e validation. This local follow-up did not re-read raw optimizer logs.
interpretation: Inherited standalone replay-fidelity/coverage gap. Initial local exact-scenario classification was too strong; M64 was observed, not invented. No wrong-shape optimized gain is demonstrated.
